description: This source file provides platform-specific shell functions for checking, copying configuration, and upgrading firmware images for particular hardware (specifically WatchGuard Firebox M300) within the OpenWrt project. It defines functions that handle different upgrade steps based on the device's board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image for the specific device, calling legacy check functions for known board types.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration data, using legacy copying functions for certain boards.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process, delegating to legacy functions or default upgrade for unknown devices.
